milestones.description: Workspace.Checkpoints contains five or more SpawnLocations named Checkpoint1 through CheckpointN with no missing stage numbers.
milestones.check:
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "Workspace.Checkpoints folder is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
        count = count + 1
    end
end
if count < 5 then
    return false, "Need at least five SpawnLocation checkpoints"
end
for stage = 1, count do
    local checkpoint = folder:FindFirstChild("Checkpoint" .. tostring(stage))
    if not checkpoint or not checkpoint:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
        return false, "Checkpoint numbering has a gap at " .. tostring(stage)
    end
end
return true, "Found " .. tostring(count) .. " consecutively numbered checkpoints"

milestones.description: Each BasePart in Workspace.KillParts has an enabled server Script named KillHandler whose source references a Touched connection and Humanoid. Source signatures are not runtime proof.
milestones.check:
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("KillParts")
if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "Workspace.KillParts folder is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, part in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false, "KillParts contains a non-part child"
    end
    local handler = part:FindFirstChild("KillHandler")
    if not handler or not handler:IsA("Script") then
        return false, "Kill part lacks server KillHandler: " .. part.Name
    end
    if not handler.Enabled or handler.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
        return false, "KillHandler is disabled or client-run: " .. part.Name
    end
    local source = handler.Source
    if not source:find("Touched:Connect", 1, true) or not source:find("Humanoid", 1, true) then
        return false, "KillHandler lacks Touched/Humanoid source signature: " .. part.Name
    end
    count = count + 1
end
if count == 0 then
    return false, "Need at least one kill part"
end
return true, "Found server KillHandler source signatures for " .. tostring(count) .. " kill parts"

milestones.description: Workspace.Finish is a BasePart with an enabled server FinishHandler Script containing a Touched connection in source.
milestones.check:
local finish = workspace:FindFirstChild("Finish")
if not finish or not finish:IsA("BasePart") then
    return false, "Workspace.Finish part is missing"
end
local handler = finish:FindFirstChild("FinishHandler")
if not handler or not handler:IsA("Script") then
    return false, "Finish needs a server FinishHandler Script"
end
if not handler.Enabled or handler.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
    return false, "FinishHandler must run on the server"
end
if not handler.Source:find("Touched:Connect", 1, true) then
    return false, "FinishHandler source lacks a Touched connection"
end
return true, "Finish part and server-side touch handler source are present"
